text.description_html:
Acorn KU5JI, Hand Forged Stainless Steel Lined Ball Knob

The Stainless Steel Lined Ball Knobset by Acorn tells a story with each of the indents left by the hammer falls of the blacksmith that made it. Its line detail gives this Acorn made knob an old world feel that is perfect for traditional decors. The natural stainless steel finish is similar to antique nickel or pewter. And because it is handmade, this knobset brings out the beautiful textures and charm of the metal from which it is made. Good for both exterior and interior use, it is easy to install and has a lifetime no-rust warranty. Made by Acorn, it will fit standard pre-drilled doors with either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets with a 1-3/4" door thickness. Available in single dummy, passage, or privacy functions.

Features of the Stainless Steel Lined Ball Knobset:

  • Fits standard pre-drilled doors.
  • Complete with rose and tubular latch.

Specifications for the Hand Forged Stainless Steel Lined Ball Knobset:

  • Finish: Stainless Steel
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Knob Diameter: 2"
  • Knob Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: A stationary knob for use as a pull or to match trim on one side of door. Complete set - 1 knob, 1 rose, and mounting screws.
  • Passage Set (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Complete set - 2 knobs, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy Set (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior knob engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior knob. Complete set - 2 knobs, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
